lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, though significantly distorted by surface light caustics.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity visible in the mid-lateral section, forming grid-like anchor points where they intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges spanning the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin; small red/pink protrusion or lesion visible on the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent environmental caustic patterns (refracted sunlight) projected across the dorsal and lateral surfaces, creating temporal high-intensity streaks that overlay the biological patterning.
